page_topic_one_liner: Get your brand cited inside ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity AI answers — not ranked on Google SERP
differentiator_vs_generic: GEO is LLM answer citation optimization via RAG retrieval. The hero visual must be an AI chat assistant reply with numbered source citations — NOT a search engine results page, magnifying glass, or SEO ranking chart.
visual_anchors: HERO (~50% canvas): ChatGPT-style dark LLM chat panel — user question bubble at top, large assistant answer below with 3 numbered citation chips [1][2][3] and chain-link icons under the answer (blurred illegible text only, NO OpenAI/Anthropic logos)
RAG retrieval flow: small web page and PDF document icons with accent arrows feeding INTO the assistant answer bubble
Subtle contrast strip: faded traditional search bar icon crossed out or smaller in background — visual 'GEO not SEO' cue without readable text
anti_patterns: Google-style SERP with blue ranked links
Search bar as the largest visual
Browser window showing search results page
SEO #1 ranking badge or position numbers
Generic growth chart as the main visual instead of LLM chat
Empty white placeholder cards below headline

en.headline: GEO & AEO STRATEGY
en.subtitle: Get Cited in AI Answers
en.composition: Visual-only editorial collage for GEO/AEO strategy (NOT SEO). HERO: Large ChatGPT-style dark LLM chat window on the right half — charcoal sidebar strip, user message bubble at top, assistant reply bubble below filling most of the panel. Inside assistant reply: blurred paragraph lines PLUS three prominent numbered citation footnote chips [1][2][3] with small chain-link icons in a row at the bottom of the answer (no readable answer text). Secondary: 2-3 small web page and PDF icons with red accent arrows pointing into the assistant bubble (RAG retrieval). Tertiary: tiny faded generic search bar in background, visually subordinate, NOT the focus. Paper torn edges, halftone grain. NO magnifying glass hero, NO SERP list, NO ranking numbers, NO empty cards.
